results.Summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2019 Camry vehicles. results.Remedy: Toyota will notify owners, and dealers will recalibrate the OCS, free of charge.  The recall began August 27, 2019.  Owners may contact Toyota customer service at 1-888-270-9371.  Toyota's number for this recall is K0M.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

results.Consequence: An incorrect label may lead to unintentionally overloading the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.

results.Summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2019 Camry vehicles. results.Remedy: Toyota will notify owners, and dealers will recalibrate the OCS, free of charge.  The recall began August 27, 2019.  Owners may contact Toyota customer service at 1-888-270-9371.  Toyota's number for this recall is K0M.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.
